sources.title: MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA
sources.snippet: The MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA node is designed to enhance the capabilities of the H3 diffusion model by applying a specialized LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) technique. This node is part of the MiniMax-H3 Turbo suite, which aims to optimize the performance of audio-video processing workflows.
